notes.title: WARGAMES Fest Update ( 0.1.2 )
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/dc5334ff96c29613a7c7dc4ff3f57ea4a5446023.png[/img]

[h2]Howdy Wastelanders,[/h2]

The next update [i]( V0.1.2 )[/i] for Battlefall: State of Conflict has now deployed to the battlefield.

[b]Our game will also be [u]20% OFF[/u] for the duration of this fest ( 28th April - 5th May )[/b]

[b]General:[/b]

Implemented better pathfinding for all ground units by:

--- [i]Units will now mostly attempt to funnel through smaller gaps to their destination as opposed to finding a longer route.[/i]

--- [i]Longer and unblocked routes may be chosen if it's no more than 12 grid spaces longer than the original route.[/i]

--- [i]If all else fails, the longer route is preferred.[/i]

--- [i]Unit 'nudging' is planned and being worked on for a later update.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/fbb218af88d66681202d1d05deda4fc0687ede75.gif[/img]

________________________________________________

* Various game optimizations. Without being specific, players should notice significant FPS boosts in 
* combat-heavy scenarios.
* Some localization fixes

[b]New content:[/b]

[b]Three new Skirmish maps:[/b]

[b]* ( 3 ) KVGC Tri-Savanna[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/19cfae640965a980fb7922b51ee31ca6e6b27720.png[/img]

[b]* ( 6 ) KVGC Showdown[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/8699fbda21c76e36370e8ef2286925a5d44c7b63.png[/img]

[b]* ( 8 ) KVGC Heat[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/87b71c07e82c74d807e86fe673414ae9695bd4b6.png[/img]

________________________________________________

New units:

* New units are in the works for all Factions but WON'T be producible in this update, however a few of them will spawn as enemies in a select number of EFNET mission maps, including:

* SEL Converter - Insta-kills enemy infantry only. Will provide 200 credits for its side whenever it kills a unit.

* SEL MindBlower - Deploys to enable a distinctly visual zone full of strange energy. Any enemy infantry/tanks that step inside this zone will be instantly converted over to the enemy players side.

* SCRAPPER Strika - A large structure on tank wheels that sends airborne Pipers to its target. Very dangerous ( and expensive ) unit.

[b]Balancing:[/b]

* Reduced build-time for Warpad ( 2400 ticks down to 1600 ticks ).
* Slightly increased weapon range of Wastelanders.
* Springer weapon max retargeting count reduced to 5 ( from 8 )
* Increased life-span of Acid-Tank warhead to 300 ticks ( from 150 )

[b]EFNET Mission map changes:[/b]

[b]Mission 06:[/b]

* Enemy SEL will receive additional backup 3 minutes into the map. ( SEL Mindblowers and SEL Converters )

[b]Mission 07:[/b]

Carved access path into area with Patriarch and Scrapper Conyard.
* Added periodic spawns of Strika Tanks for enemy player if playing in co-op mode.

[b]Mission 08:[/b]

* Added periodic spawns of Strika Tanks for enemy player.

______________________________________

As always, if you want to participate directly and maybe get a sneak peek of what we're working on for next patch [url=https://discord.gg/tQK34Ucy4H]join our Discord[/url]!

Lelouche and Tenex
Kyoto Video Game Concern

notes.title: Battlefall: State of Conflict - 0.1.1 UPDATE + Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Commanders,[/h3]

The first update for Battlefall: State of Conflict is here! These changes address many of your most prominent comments about, and requests for, the game. 

[b]Visibility[/b]:
[list]
[*] Increased ambient lighting across all Campaign and Skirmish maps
[*] Explosions now animate faster and are more transparent
[*] Slightly increased transparency of snow and rain
[/list]
[i]It's a bright sun-shiny day in the wasteland. Bring your shades if you go topside![/i]

[b]Gameplay[/b]:
[list]
[*] Units attacking flying units will now correctly move towards the target instead of the clicked location 
[*] Decreased the default game speed from 80% to 70% - this affects the Campaign and Skirmish maps that do not have the extra Game Speed modifier applied
[*] Increased the default production speed of all units/structures by 20% - this affects the Campaign 
 and Skirmish maps that do not have the Production Speed modifier applied
[/list]
[i]The production Speed benefit from [b]multiple production structures[/b] should be much more noticeable on both factions in this patch.
[/i]
[b]Resolution & UI Options[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fullscreen/Windowed Mode can now be toggled
[*] Added option to enable or disable locking the mouse cursor to the application view
[*] Added resolution settings: ( "1024 x 576" , "1152 x 648" , "1280 x 720" , "1366 x 768" , "1600 x 900" , "1920 x 1080" )
[/list]
[i]Players using Windowed mode can now have a distinct Battlefall window up to 1920x1080 in resolution. For now, Fullscreen mode will continue to use the familiar automatic Aspect Ratio Scaler in resolutions greater than 1080. Support for more options will arrive in future updates.[/i]

[b]Audio[/b]:
[list]
[*] Added a 1s timeout to Unit Voices ( Select/Move/Attack ) to prevent audio spam
[*] Reduced the volume of the Hind's Select/Move/Attack VO's
[*] Added an audio cue when a player joins your lobby
[/list]
[b]EFNET Mission 02 / Salvage Rights[/b]:
[list]
[*] Prevented units being able to accidentally destroy cargo
[/list]
[b]EFNET Mission 03 / Shattered Communications[/b]:
[list]
[*] The AI will not initiate an attack or produce any forces for the first 2 minutes of the map
[/list]
[b]EFNET Mission 09 / Into the Hive[/b]:
[list]
[*] Lowered the difficulty by removing periodic waves of Scrapper birds
[*] AI's will no longer spam Scrapper Armour tanks
[/list]
[i]The Campaign should still feel challenging but not as frustrating. [/i]

[b]Misc[/b]:
[list]
[*] Changed video format of Main Menu background. Should fix Linux users and others experiencing low FPS only in Main Menu
[*] Halved the speed of edge scrolling on slow/fast modes
[/list]

We want to thank each and every one of our players for giving the game a go since launch. This is the first patch on our journey forward together!

We're [b]hard at work[/b] addressing players feedback about [b]pathfinding[/b] in our game--rest assured this is of utmost priority to us and we'll have an update for you all soon. As always, if you want to participate directly and maybe get a sneak peek of what we're working on for next patch [url=https://discord.gg/tQK34Ucy4H]join our Discord[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/fbb218af88d66681202d1d05deda4fc0687ede75.gif[/img]

Lelouche and Tenex
Kyoto Video Game Concern

notes.title: Battlefall: State of Conflict Development Roadmap
notes.content:
[h2][b]Battlefall: State of Conflict has officially launched in Early Access 🚀 and it's time to talk about our plans for the future of the game![/b][/h2]


We have planned a lot of content and content creation tools for you. How much we get done and how quickly will be on the two of us. Our publisher, the venerable MicroProse, is backing us all the way. But we can't do this without you: as players and as our community you are critical to helping shape the game in its final state. 

[h3]
[b]What you get[/b] when you buy Battlefall: State of Conflict [b]today[/b]: [/h3]

🗺️ [b]17 Skirmish Maps[/b] – Online or Offline. With friends or against them. Up to 2 players and 6 bots!
📖 [b]9 Campaign Missions[/b] – The war begins with the first fully voiced chapter of Battlefall’s story. Go it alone or complete the whole campaign online in co-op with an other player.
✍️ [b]6 Written Languages[/b]: ENGLISH + DEUTSCH + ESPAÑOL + Русский + 조선말  + 汉语
🔥 [b]2 Playable Factions[/b] – EFNET: the hard-nosed Earth Forces Network trying to restore humanity's rule over Earth and the SCRAPPERS: mutated psychos with a unique approach to, well, everything.
🌎 [b]2 Battlefield Environments[/b] – Fight for control in Arctic and Desert warzones with a preview of Urban warfare.
⚔️ [b]Multiplayer & Co-Op[/b] – Challenge others online or team up for campaign co-op battles.
🔎 [b]A full advanced tutorial[/b] - Learn the ins and outs before the real battles begin to get the upper hand on your opponents.
🎭 [b]Hundreds of Voiceovers[/b] – Fully acted campaign missions and units that bring every moment in Battlefall to life.
🧨 [b]Lobby Modifiers[/b] - Make, save, and load presets that give all players things like faster units, more $$, restricted upgrades. Over 20 modifiers at launch! Your war, your way.


[h3][b]What we're working on[/b] now:[/h3]

Full support for [b]4 Player Online Multiplayer[/b]
Building the [b]SCRAPPER campaign[/b]
Completing the [b]DESERT tileset[/b]
[b]Balancing[/b] EFNET and SCRAPPERS
Addressing [b]player feedback
[/b]

[h3]What's [b]after that[/b]:[/h3]

[b]SEL[/b], the third faction
The [b]SEL Campaign[/b]
The [b]TEMPERATE and URBAN tilesets[/b]
[b]Super Units[/b]
[b]Super Weapons[/b]
[b]More[/b] Official [b]Maps[/b]


[h3]What we want you to have [b]when we're done[/b]:[/h3]

[b]Tons of achievements[/b]
Custom[b] Map Creator[/b]
Custom [b]Ruleset Editor[/b]
[b]Steam Workshop[/b] integration
[b]Random Map Generator[/b] with lots of toggles
[b]A lifetime of[/b] customized and community generated [b]content[/b]


Join us in game, on Discord, or in the Steam Discussion forums to play and talk about the future of Battlefall!

— Tenex and Lelouche

Hey Commanders,

See you at the frontline!

We've heard your many compliments and criticisms and we've already put together a list of improvements which we'll share soon. We are excited to hear your continued feedback about the demo this week. Hop on [url=https://discord.com/invite/U4XeA2k]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think!

Much to our surprise we have almost made it to 10,000 wishlists (ːsteamthisː). We are overwhelmed by your support! Thank you! If you haven't yet, please WISHLIST the game and Share the page with your friends! With your continued support we can smash the 10K milestone!

Join us in our EXTENDED MULTIPLAYER EVENT from Oct 21st to Oct 28th!

Sincerely,

Lelouche & Tenex

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE: Endless Fest King of the Hill Mode, Veterancy system, and more!
notes.content:
[h1]Commanders,[/h1]


Today we're pleased to announce our participation in Steam's[b] Endless Replayability Fest[/b]! We have a HUGE new patch for you with many new features and QoL updates


[h3][b]King of the Hill Game Mode[/b][/h3]
A thrilling new map where the player occupies a central base and is tasked with fending off [i]endless waves of enemies[/i] from all directions. Each wave is different from, and more difficult than, the last. We think KotH is A LOT OF FUN and [i]a real challenge[/i] to play! Don't get too comfortable waiting around... you never know what might happen...

You can share your bragging rights by [b]screenshotting [/b]and[b] sharing [/b] our new built-in end-game stat summary on Steam or social media. Or send them to us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/U4XeA2k]Discord[/url]. We can't wait to see how many waves you can survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/c68c5d40a4da562bf7ee30fc30fdfdd6540a41b9.png[/img]

[h3][b]Veterancy[/b][/h3]
Battlefall: State of Conflict now features an automated unit upgrade system--Veterancy--which provides units that make a certain amount of kills with permanent bonuses like: increased max health, increased movement speed, health regeneration, and in some cases a different, or additional, weapon. Units achieving Veterancy will receive a badge on their unit UI indicating their new Veterancy Level. Level 1 is a small silver badge. Level 2 adds a pair of shiny golden wings to the badge.

Veteran units can be faster, tougher, do more damage and bring new weapons to the fight. Use them wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/42430ba518d5019768dc1549f94fcf78f026a6dd.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Refinery[/b][/h3]
The Ore Refinery has received a temporary function update for Endless Fest: Ore storage is now unlimited. Mining trucks will only briefly line up to drop off ore before turning to gather more. The rate of ore processing, 120 credits per second, remains unchanged. 

The Ore Refinery has received a new permanent visual update that integrates the Current Ore Storage into the building's art via live display. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/39d9620b6dfa467fb6281d20ad465205c9282297.png[/img]

[h3][b]Smooth Turning[/b][/h3]
A major vehicle movement update that allows units to make more natural turning arcs.

We think you'll agree that it's a huge improvement to game look and feel.

[h3][b]Patch Notes Summary[/b][/h3]
-King of the Hill game mode added
-KotH wave system with randomization added
-KotH Voiceovers added
-KotH Post-game stats summary
-Mission Objectives UI updated
-Unit Veterancy system added with 2 levelups possible
-Veterancy UI and SFX added
-Refinery building's ore storage is temporarily set to unlimited. Processing remains unchanged
-Refinery building storage UI updated and integrated into building art
-Miner truck storage UI updated
-Significant performance improvements, specifically with large-scale battles on screen
-Flying units now have unique death animations with crashes and SFX

As always [b]we thank you[/b] for playing our live service DEMO as we march toward Early Access Launch. Follow, Wishlist and come chat on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/U4XeA2k]Discord[/url] to keep up to date with everything Battlefall!

notes.title: Battlefall: State of Conflict - New Map and Custom Difficulty Sliders Added!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Commanders,[/b][/h1]

Today we're patching OUT some bugs and IN some exciting changes and features!


[b][h2]IN:[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Significant [b]performance improvements[/b] on maps with high unit counts
[*] [b]Menu music[/b] will now continue to play through our entire soundtrack rather than repeating the original Demo menu music
[*] [b]Unit weapon ranges[/b] have been UNIVERSALLY halved so that they scale appropriately to the map
[*] Weapons that deal an [b]area-of-effect damage[/b] now deal damage more consistently
[*] A [b]NEW[/b] Skirmish map featuring [b]1v1v1 Free-For-All[/b] gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/74e6a54466f7b9433a40b39bb29301819968c39c.png[/img]

[*] Skirmish mode has received a [b]CUSTOM difficulty menu[/b] where players can customize the following:


Game speed [b]0.5[/b] to [b]1.5x[/b]
Starting Money [b]7500[/b] to [b]$37500[/b]
Production Time [b]0.5[/b] to [b]1.5x[/b]
Production Cost [b]0[/b] to [b]2.0x[/b]
Unit/Structure HP [b]0.5[/b] to [b]2.5x[/b]
and Credits Per Ore [b]0.5[/b] to [b]2.5x[/b][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43852137/c21a704c87461c0f469957c902e1274b5364dcb6.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]OUT:[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Players were sometimes able delete buildings with DEL key, even while paused. This should no longer be the case
[*] Innumerable typos
[/list]

[h2][b]THANK YOU![/b][/h2]

We want our players to know we are committed to [b]maximal player freedom[/b]. While the Campaign will be a curated experience featuring our writing, and our ideas, the way you play the Skirmish modes privately and socially online will be very broadly up to you. The Skirmish Custom Difficulty Slider is only [b]the first of many[/b] feature updates focused on delivering on these principles. 

There will now be a brief slowdown in content patches as we prepare our Roadmap and plan the first patch of the Roadmap updates. [b]Hotfixes will continue[/b] and [b]we are still here[/b] reading and responding to your comments on Steam Discussions and Discord. 

Thank you for playing so many hours of our game and for your excellent feedback, ideas, and bug reports. Our small team feels much larger thanks to you. 

We are on the road to EA launch! [i][url=https://discord.gg/tQK34Ucy4H]Join us![/url][/i]
